result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual problems: a duplicated restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, truncated text on the third carousel card, and a partially cut-off filter chip with no visible label. Some edge clipping (third card, bottom pizza card) is likely intentional carousel/scroll behavior but the duplication and truncation stand out as defects.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards side by side (same image, same 15–25 min badge, same €0.90 delivery), which looks like a data/rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate the restaurant list before rendering the carousel (e.g., filter by unique restaurant ID) so each venue appears only once.

issues.description: The third carousel card's title is truncated as 'Smash Bros Bu' with no ellipsis, making the name look abruptly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis (or equivalent truncation) to card titles, or wrap to a second line, so partial words don't appear raw-clipped.

issues.description: A sixth category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right screen edge showing only a small empty sliver with no readable label.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partially visible chips still show enough of their label to hint at scrollability, or add a fade/gradient edge to clearly signal horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card (with the −20% badge) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible title, rating, or delivery info, so the promo lacks context in the current viewport.
issues.suggestion: If this is simply below-the-fold content it's acceptable, but consider adjusting section spacing or padding above the bottom nav so cards aren't awkwardly cropped mid-image.
